# Draft:Jack Edward Sawyers

Jack Edward Sawyers (born 24 September 1967 in Bridgeton, New Jersey) is best known as an entertainment industry creative executive in the field of Film, Television as well as music videos and documentaries. Starting his career in the 1980s and still going.  Working with established production companies in the late 80s for several years until creating his own production and post production companies along the way With a range of project business partners throughout the years including Mark Rezyka, Frankie Banali, Bob Kulick, Jeff Roberts and Paul Gleason, he Co founded 2RS Studios in 2002, with Roberts creating many home video distribution DVD titles with notable music acts including Quiet Riot, Stryper, Vanilla Fudge as well as TV Content for many cable outlets. 2RS Studios was also a post house for editing, creating visual effects as well as a high volume of DVD authoring projects.
